overview: The committee met to coordinate upcoming neighborhood ward meetings and reviewed major proposals to modernize the city's noise ordinance and website. Both the noise ordinance draft and the website improvement plan were kept in committee to allow for further public input and consultation with city departments.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: The committee discussed a resolution authorizing them to draft and approve a regular council newsletter without referring it to a regular council meeting and noted that the summer and September editions would be published shortly.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Chair Mullane summarized the feedback from the inaugural Ward 1 meeting and the committee coordinated the schedule for remaining ward meetings through February 2027.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: Councilor Tseng presented a draft noise ordinance based on Somerville's model that introduces measurable decibel limits, a schedule of 17 specific disturbances, and a non-criminal fine structure. The item was kept in committee to allow for a public survey and consultation with businesses and the police department.

items.title: City Website Improvements
items.summary: The committee reviewed an audit of MedfordMass.org that identified outdated content, broken links, and accessibility issues, proposing a tiered plan for fixes ranging from quick content updates to structural platform changes. The matter was kept in committee with plans to invite the IT and Communications departments to a future meeting.
